newsitem.title: USA: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear unit off-line until summer.
newsitem.headline: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear unit off-line until summer.

text.p: The 1,158 megawatt (MW) WNP-2 nuclear unit in Washington state was taken off-line Thursday morning, slightly ahead of a schedule to shut down early Friday morning, a spokesman for the plant said.
WNP-2 was shut after testing of a reactor feed pump did not go as expected, he said.
The unit is expected to remain out of service until late June or early July amid a regional oversupply of lower-cost hydropower.
WNP-2 will begin an annual refueling outage on April 18.
